summary: SUP-1008 experienced a factory outage on 2026-12-02 due to a fire on Line 2, halting production for an expected 48 hours. Two purchase orders (PO-1001 and PO-1002) for item ITM-501 are affected, with a combined exposure of INR 491400.00. Current inventory provides 1.5 days of coverage, and both POs will experience shortages. The biggest unknown is when SUP-1008 will restart production and deliver the orders.
